title: [podman-6.2] storage: Fix leak in applyLayerHandler
body:
This is a back-port of (merge from a private fork):
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/commit/a146c8aa68b6d44edf047d023d284c39ad29156d

Cherry-picked from:
cb65d396d1ee31f4ae65d690575a03accaf206a0

```
DecompressStream returns an io.ReadCloser
and the Close() method was not called for
all execution paths when used by ApplyLayer()
and ApplyUncompressedLayer through the shared
applyLayerHandler in storage/pkg/archive/diff.go
leading to a resource leak.

Call the Close() method on the returned ReadCloser.
```
